item.description: President Xi Jinping will discuss “world peace” with Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin on Thursday in the first-ever trilateral meeting between the leaders of China, the US and Russia. The talks “will be of groundbreaking significance”, a Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson said on Monday. item.title: ‘Nobody wins the future alone’: John Lee calls for collaboration at Apec
item.description: Hong Kong’s leader has urged Apec business leaders to “prosper and win together” in an increasingly complex global environment, positioning the city as a springboard for businesses seeking to enter the mainland Chinese market.
